description: Resolve a name to concept URIs (people, organisations, places, Wikipedia topics). Pass the returned `uri` as concept_uris to search_articles / search_events — much more precise than a keyword. Does not consume search tokens. Sorted by prominence in the news; check `type` and `label` to pick the right homonym.

lang.description: Language of the prefix, ISO 639-3 (default eng).

prefix.description: Text typed so far (a name or the start of one), e.g. "Telef" or "bbc".

types.description: Restrict to these concept kinds (default: all). Accepts a single string or an array of strings.

name: suggest_concepts
